ml5_alert_budget.source: Synthetic fleet (seed 41): 50 pumps x 365 days of daily scores, 30 distinct events (at least 13 days apart on a pump) with precursors of random strength in the 5 days before; alert episodes = runs of alert days outside warning windows.

ml5_alert_policy.source: Schematic alert pipeline; persistence and cooldown values are illustrative policy choices, not recommendations.

ml5_anomaly_methods.source: Synthetic two-cluster reference set (seed 42); IsolationForest(random_state=42), LocalOutlierFactor(n_neighbors=20, novelty=True), OneClassSVM(nu=0.08, gamma=0.8); shading = -score_samples clipped to its 2nd-98th percentiles.

ml5_anomaly_types.source: Synthetic hourly series (seed 11): daily cycle plus noise with an injected spike, four peak-level hours at trough time, and a 22-hour flat segment.

ml5_bayesopt.source: Synthetic 1-D objective; scikit-learn GaussianProcessRegressor, Matern 2.5 kernel with fixed length scale 0.8 and variance 2 on normalized scores, fitted to 4 trials; expected improvement, xi = 0.01.

ml5_class_weight.source: Synthetic 2-D data (seed 9), 5% events, 50/50 stratified split; logistic regression. Right: unweighted model with threshold 0.060, chosen to match the balanced model's training recall. Plots show 900 random test rows.

ml5_course_map.source: Schematic of the course workflow; chips show where each module teaches the stage.

ml5_drift_psi.source: Synthetic intake pressure (seed 15): reference N(120, 10), 5,000 rows; current N(125, 12), 1,500 rows. PSI over reference deciles = 0.248; two-sample KS D = 0.199, p = 2.6e-40.

ml5_drift_types.source: Synthetic data (seed 14): events when x2 > 0.25 x1^2 + c; logistic regression fitted on the reference period only. Data drift moves the inputs; concept drift lowers c from 1.0 to 0.2.

ml5_event_timeline.source: Synthetic 30-day hourly detector score (seed 22) with three events of 6 h; alert rows above threshold 1.5 merged into episodes when gaps are 6 h or less.

ml5_fences.source: Synthetic GR-like mixture (seed 21): 900 sand rows N(38, 9), 100 shale rows N(102, 9), three tool spikes. Fence counts computed on the full sample.

ml5_fleet_timeline.source: Synthetic fleet (seed 5): 10 pumps, 730 days, 9 trips; zoomed current trace is synthetic and illustrative, not field data.

ml5_grid_random.source: Synthetic objective: score = g(important) + h(unimportant), with a narrow optimum at 0.72 on the important axis (teal curves). Random trials: one draw (seed 40); 9 random trials land within 0.05 of the optimum with probability 1 - 0.9^9 = 0.61.

ml5_halving.source: Simulated learning curves for 27 candidates (seed 8): score = q - b / sqrt(budget) + noise; top third kept at each rung (factor 3).

ml5_iforest_paths.source: Path lengths of the two highlighted rows over 1,000 fully grown random isolation paths (seeds 0-999) on the 61-row synthetic sample; s = 2^(-mean path / c(n)).

ml5_iforest_splits.source: Synthetic 2-D sample (seed 2): 60 ordinary rows plus one unusual row. One random isolation path per row (path seeds 2 and 1); cuts numbered in order, the right panel zooms on the dashed box.

ml5_lab1_results.source: Computed from well_logs_data.csv (course data): 27,845 rows, 5,493 complete in GR, RHOB, NPHI, DT, CALI, BS; StandardScaler; IsolationForest(n_estimators=100, random_state=42); scikit-learn 1.7.

ml5_lab2_overlap.source: Computed from well_logs_data.csv (course data), 5,493 complete rows; lab settings (contamination / nu = 0.05, LOF n_neighbors = 20, OCSVM gamma = "scale"); scikit-learn 1.7.

ml5_lifecycle.source: Schematic model lifecycle with a monitoring feedback loop.

ml5_lof_k.source: Synthetic data (seed 12): 300 ordinary rows, an 8-row micro-cluster, 3 isolated rows. Rings mark the 11 highest LOF scores at each n_neighbors.

ml5_lof_mechanism.source: Synthetic clusters (seed 8); scikit-learn LocalOutlierFactor with n_neighbors=6. Dashed circles: k-distance of A and B; grey circles: k-distance of one neighbour of each.

ml5_mahalanobis.source: Synthetic correlated features (seed 4, correlation 0.9, 300 rows). Contour at the chi-square(2) 99% radius 3.03; test point distance 6.48.

ml5_masking.source: Synthetic readings (seed 3): 200 ordinary N(50, 2) plus 25 offset N(65, 0.8). Mean 51.70, SD 5.16; median 50.31, MAD 1.45; ordinary rows flagged by the robust rule: 0.

ml5_nested_cv.source: Schematic nested cross-validation: 5 outer folds, 4 inner folds.

ml5_ocsvm_gamma.source: Synthetic arc-shaped reference data (seed 6, 260 rows, standardized); scikit-learn OneClassSVM, RBF kernel, nu = 0.05. Shaded: decision function >= 0. Flag rates on 2,000 new rows from the same generator (seed 60).

ml5_one_se.source: Synthetic data (make_classification, seed 20, 800 rows); DecisionTreeClassifier, StratifiedKFold(10, shuffle, seed 0); error bars = standard error across folds.

ml5_paired_folds.source: Synthetic data (make_classification, seed 4, 1,200 rows, about 16% events); RepeatedStratifiedKFold 5x2 (seed 0). Mean difference 0.0126, SD 0.0173; naive SE 0.0055; corrected SE 0.0103 (Nadeau-Bengio, test/train = 0.25).

ml5_pca_recon.source: Left: synthetic correlated pair (seed 13), one principal component. Right: six synthetic channels from two latent factors (seed 32); PCA fitted on hours 0–299; threshold 0.170 = 99th percentile of hours 300–419; sensor 4 drifts +0.008 SD per hour from hour 520.

ml5_prevalence_tree.source: Exact arithmetic for 10,000 rows, 1% prevalence, recall 80%, false-positive rate 5%.

ml5_recall_ci.source: Exact Clopper–Pearson 95% intervals for an observed recall of 80% at six event counts (scipy.stats.beta).

ml5_reliability.source: Synthetic data (make_classification, seed 5, 40,000 rows, 5.5% events, 50/50 split); logistic regression. Prior correction p = b*ps / (b*ps - ps + 1) with b = 0.0581 (negatives kept).

ml5_roc_pr_prevalence.source: Exact binormal scores: ordinary N(0, 1), events N(1.5, 1). Dots mark the threshold with FPR 5% (recall 0.44) and its precision; dotted lines show each prevalence.

ml5_settings.source: Synthetic 2-D data (seed 7). Isolation Forest ranks the contaminated set; novelty LOF (n_neighbors=20) scores new rows; logistic regression separates labelled events.

ml5_ts_residual.source: Same synthetic load (seed 17). Seasonal forecast = median of the same hour over the previous 7 days; residual scaled by median and MAD of days 7–14; threshold 3.5.

ml5_ts_rolling.source: Synthetic hourly load (seed 17): daily cycle, slow trend, AR(1) noise; five afternoon hours near day 16.5 set to night level. Minimum trailing 24-h z-score in the anomaly: -1.52.
